analyst_view.overall: Marseille (31st, 3 points) host Levski Sofia (10th, 7 points) at the Velodrome, and after three straight Europa League defeats Bruno Genesio's side need a win to stay in the race for the knockout play-off places. They arrive in good form: four wins in a row, including 1-0 at Leverkusen in this competition and 2-1 at Lens, and they play Le Mans in Ligue 1 tonight before going to Auxerre on Sunday. The squad is thin after a summer with six starters leaving and no signings, so heavy rotation is unlikely; Derek Cornelius and Emerson are the known absentees and are long-term. Levski lost the Sofia derby 0-3 to CSKA last time out and are without Asen Mitkov and Radoslav Kirilov. Nothing here clearly differs from what the numbers already show, so I stay with them on every stat.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.3 goals, 2.6 of them for Marseille, and already trim Levski for scoring only 4 in their last 6. Marseille's must-win situation and good form point up, but Levski have been tight away (1-1 at NEC, 2-1 win at Plzen) and Marseille's thin squad plays again on Sunday, so I stay at about 3.3.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, 7.1 for Marseille. Levski usually defend deep away from home, which pushes corners Marseille's way, but that is in the numbers already, as is both teams' lower recent corner count. I stay at about 9.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards and already lower Levski for few bookings lately (-7.8%). No referee is named yet; a Levski side sitting deep could pick up some cards, but nothing new suggests a heated game, so I stay at about 4.0.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.1 shots, 19.6 for Marseille. Marseille need the win and should have long spells of pressure, which the numbers already expect, and a full squad apart from Cornelius and Emerson means no big change. I stay at about 28.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.1 on target and already trim both sides for recent accuracy. Marseille's attack (Gouiri, Paixao) is in form after four straight wins, but that is reflected in the base, so I stay at about 10.
